caseName: Stein v. Conference of Federal Savings & Loan Associations
caseNameFull: Stein, Secretary of the Business and Transportation Agency of California v. Conference of Federal Savings and Loan Associations

opinions.text: Appeal from C. A. 9th Cir. Motions of NAACP Legal Defense & Educational Fund, Inc., and American Savings & Loan League for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. Judgment affirmed.
